# Press Releases


Dario CEO Erez Raphael to Lead Panel Discussion at U.S. Bancorp | BTIG Tech-Enabled Healthcare Forum


-


-


-


-


*Erez Raphael will be joined by Personify Health President Ed Liebowitz for panel discussion on the evolving digital health market, including member choice, multi-condition care, engagement and ROI*


NEW YORK


, Nov. 20, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[DarioHealth Corp.](https://www.dariohealth.com/) (NASDAQ: DRIO) (the "Company", "DarioHealth" or "Dario"), a leading AI-powered healthcare technology company transforming the management of chronic conditions, today announced that Erez Raphael, the Company's Chief Executive Officer, has been invited to lead a panel discussion at the U.S. Bancorp | BTIG Tech-Enabled Healthcare Forum 2026, being held virtually on Monday, November 23, 2026.


Erez Raphael and Ed Liebowitz, President of[Personify Health](https://personifyhealth.com/) , a Dario channel partner, will conduct a panel discussion on the latest trends in digital health. Personify Health, a personalized health platform company that helps organizations manage risk end-to-end, is a channel partner offering Dario's high return-on-investment ("ROI") multi-condition platform to its 1,000+ active clients and 31 million lives reached. By working with channel partners such as Personify, Dario employs a one-to-many distribution model that enables the Company to efficiently add new enterprise clients at lower acquisition costs, supporting scalable growth without a proportional increase in sales and marketing investment.


**U.S. Bancorp | BTIG Tech-Enabled Healthcare Forum 2026**


Panel Discussion: *"Chosen by Members, Funded by Payers: Delivering a Full Health Platform Ecosystem"*


Panelists: Erez Raphael and Ed Liebowitz


Time: 12:00 p.m. to 12:50 p.m. EST


Topics:


- Growing member choice and its impact on how digital health solutions are purchased
- Driving sustained engagement while demonstrating measurable clinical and financial ROI
- Managing multiple chronic conditions through integrated platforms versus point solutions
- Improving outcomes and value associated with GLP-1


therapy
- Integrating navigation and clinical platforms to create a more unified member experience


For more information about the conference or to schedule a meeting with Dario's management, please contact your U.S. Bancorp | BTIG representative.


**About DarioHealth Corp.**


DarioHealth (Nasdaq: DRIO) is an AI-powered healthcare technology company helping health plans, health systems and employers improve health outcomes while lowering the cost of care. The Company's integrated platform combines connected devices, personalized member engagement, AI-driven insights and provider-backed clinical care to support people living with conditions including diabetes, hypertension, weight management, musculoskeletal and behavioral health needs.


Powered by more than 13 billion proprietary longitudinal healthcare data points collected over more than a decade, Dario's AI platform personalizes care at the individual member level by analyzing biometric, clinical and behavioral data to deliver more timely and effective interventions. By combining engagement, clinical intelligence and care delivery within a single platform, Dario helps customers address multiple chronic conditions through one solution.
